local function Slider(name, min, max, default, callback)

    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.Parent = Content

    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")

    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Text = name
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    title.TextSize = 14
    title.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.Parent = frame

    local val = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    val.Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, 6)
    val.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    val.TextSize = 13

    val.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    val.Parent = frame

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 5)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 38)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Parent = frame
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((default-min)/(max-min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Primary
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = bar
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local dragging = false
    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = true end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            local rel = math.clamp((i.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
            local v = math.floor(min + (max-min)*rel)
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
            val.Text = tostring(v)
            callback(v)
        end
    end)
end

local function Button(name, callback)

            SelectedLabel.TextColor3 = Theme.Primary

local function RefreshPlayerList()

    for _, child in ipairs(PlayerListFrame:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28)
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
            btn.Text = plr.Name

            btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
            btn.Parent = PlayerListFrame
            Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
            btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                SetTarget(plr)

Section("MOVEMENT")

Toggle("Normal Fly", "Classic flight", function(on)
    State.NormalFly = on
    if State.AnimFly then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return end
    if on then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Name = "ED_Fly"
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bv.Parent = root
        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bg.Name = "ED_Gyro"
        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bg.P = 10000
        bg.Parent = root
        State.FlyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not State.NormalFly then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit * 50 end
            bv.Velocity = dir
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame
        end)
    else
        if State.FlyConn then State.FlyConn:Disconnect() State.FlyConn = nil end
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_Fly") then root.ED_Fly:Destroy() end
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_Gyro") then root.ED_Gyro:Destroy() end
    end
end)

Toggle("Animated Fly", "Fly with cool animation", function(on)
    State.AnimFly = on
    if State.NormalFly then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return end
    if on then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.Name = "ED_AnimFly"
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bv.Parent = root
        local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bg.Name = "ED_AnimGyro"
        bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9,9e9,9e9)
        bg.P = 3000
        bg.Parent = root
        local angle = 0
        State.AnimFlyConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
            if not State.AnimFly then return end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local dir = Vector3.zero
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= cam.CFrame.LookVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += cam.CFrame.RightVector end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
            if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit * 55; angle = angle + dt * 8 else angle = angle + dt * 2 end
            bv.Velocity = dir
            bg.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(math.sin(angle)*15), 0, math.rad(math.cos(angle)*25))
        end)
    else
        if State.AnimFlyConn then State.AnimFlyConn:Disconnect() State.AnimFlyConn = nil end
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_AnimFly") then root.ED_AnimFly:Destroy() end
        if root:FindFirstChild("ED_AnimGyro") then root.ED_AnimGyro:Destroy() end
    end
end)

Slider("Speed", 16, 250, 16, function(v)
    State.Speed = v
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character

end)

Toggle("NoClip", "Walk through walls", function(on)
    State.NoClip = on
    if on then
        State.NoClipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not State.NoClip then return end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.NoClipConn then State.NoClipConn:Disconnect() State.NoClipConn = nil end
    end
end)

-- Anti Fling
Toggle("Anti Fling", "Stops other players from flinging you", function(on)
    State.AntiFling = on
    if on then
        State.AntiFlingConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if not State.AntiFling then return end
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.AntiFlingConn then
            State.AntiFlingConn:Disconnect()
            State.AntiFlingConn = nil
        end
        -- Restore collision
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

Toggle("Target Lock", "Auto lock when you click near someone", function(on)
    State.TargetLock = on
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
    if gp or not State.TargetLock then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y)
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local result = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 50, params)
    if result and result.Instance then
        local model = result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
        if model then
            local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
            if plr and plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                SetTarget(plr)
                return
            end
        end
    end

    local closest, dist = nil, 12
    local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local other = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local toOther = (other.Position - root.Position)
            local d = toOther.Magnitude
            if d < dist and toOther.Unit:Dot(look) > 0.4 then
                dist = d
                closest = plr
            end
        end
    end
    if closest then SetTarget(closest) end
end)

Toggle("Touch Fling", "Fling players on touch", function(on)
    State.TouchFling = on
    if not ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("juisdfj0i32i0eidsuf0iok") then
        local detection = Instance.new("Decal")
        detection.Name = "juisdfj0i32i0eidsuf0iok"
        detection.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
    end
    if on then
        task.spawn(function()
            local movel = 0.1
            while State.TouchFling do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                local c = LocalPlayer.Character
                local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if hrp then
                    local vel = hrp.Velocity
                    hrp.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
                    RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                    hrp.Velocity = vel
                    RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                    hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)
                    movel = -movel
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Toggle("Attach", "Attach to selected player", function(on)
    State.Attach = on
    if on then
        if not State.Target then return end
        State.AttachConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not State.Attach or not State.Target or not State.Target.Character then return end
            local my = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local tr = State.Target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if my and tr then
                my.CFrame = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 2.5)
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.AttachConn then State.AttachConn:Disconnect() State.AttachConn = nil end
    end
end)

Button("Teleport to Selected", function()
    if not State.Target or not State.Target.Character then return end
    local my = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local tr = State.Target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if my and tr then
        my.CFrame = tr.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
    end
end)

Toggle("Kill Aura", "Damage nearby players", function(on)
    State.KillAura = on
    if on then
        State.KillAuraConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not State.KillAura then return end
            local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myRoot then return end
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
                    local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    local root = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hum and root and hum.Health > 0 then
                        local dist = (myRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist <= 15 then
                            pcall(function() hum:TakeDamage(10) end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if State.KillAuraConn then State.KillAuraConn:Disconnect() State.KillAuraConn = nil end
    end
end)

scripts.features: A lightweight Roblox LocalScript providing smooth walk and run camera bobbing, mouse-turn camera tilt, spring-driven jump and landing impact without camera pitch distortion, and procedural character body leaning for both R6 and R15 rigs.
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local character, humanoid, rootPart, rootJoint
local originalRootC0 = CFrame.new()

local jumpOffset = 0
local jumpVelocity = 0

local function setupCharacter(char)
 character = char
 humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
 rootPart = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 
 rootJoint = rootPart:FindFirstChild("RootJoint") 
  or (char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") and char.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("RootJoint"))
 
 if rootJoint then
  originalRootC0 = rootJoint.C0
 end

 humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
  if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
   jumpVelocity = -0.15
  elseif newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
   local fallSpeed = math.abs(rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y)
   local impact = math.clamp(fallSpeed / 35, 0.15, 0.45)
   jumpVelocity = -impact
  end
 end)
end

if player.Character then setupCharacter(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)

local WALK_INTENSITY = 0.16
local WALK_FREQ = 10

local RUN_INTENSITY = 0.30
local RUN_FREQ = 14

local TILT_INTENSITY = 0.06
local LERP_SPEED = 0.18

local tickCounter = 0
local lastCameraRotation = camera.CFrame
local currentCameraTilt = 0
local currentBobOffset = Vector3.new()
local currentBodyTilt = Vector3.new()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
 if not humanoid or not rootPart or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return end

 local velocity = rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
 local currentSpeed = velocity.Magnitude
 local isGrounded = humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air

 if currentSpeed > 0.5 and isGrounded then
  local isRunning = currentSpeed > 18
  local intensity = isRunning and RUN_INTENSITY or WALK_INTENSITY
  local freq = isRunning and RUN_FREQ or WALK_FREQ

  tickCounter += deltaTime * freq

  local bobX = math.cos(tickCounter * 0.5) * (intensity * 0.65)
  local bobY = math.abs(math.sin(tickCounter)) * intensity

  currentBobOffset = currentBobOffset:Lerp(Vector3.new(bobX, bobY, 0), LERP_SPEED)
 else
  tickCounter = 0
  currentBobOffset = currentBobOffset:Lerp(Vector3.new(), LERP_SPEED)
 end

 local springStiffness = 180
 local springDamping = 12
 local force = -springStiffness * jumpOffset - springDamping * jumpVelocity
 jumpVelocity += force * deltaTime
 jumpOffset += jumpVelocity * deltaTime

 local deltaCFrame = camera.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(lastCameraRotation)
 local _, yawDelta = deltaCFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
 lastCameraRotation = camera.CFrame

 local targetCamTilt = math.clamp(yawDelta * 1.5, -TILT_INTENSITY, TILT_INTENSITY)
 currentCameraTilt = currentCameraTilt + (targetCamTilt - currentCameraTilt) * LERP_SPEED

 camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame 
  * CFrame.new(currentBobOffset.X, currentBobOffset.Y + jumpOffset, 0)
  * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, currentCameraTilt)

 if rootJoint then
  local localVel = rootPart.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(velocity)
  
  local targetBodyX = -localVel.Z * 0.015
  local targetBodyZ = localVel.X * 0.015
  local targetBodyY = -yawDelta * 0.5

  currentBodyTilt = currentBodyTilt:Lerp(Vector3.new(targetBodyX, targetBodyY, targetBodyZ), LERP_SPEED)

  local bodyBobY = (currentBobOffset.Y * 0.5) + (jumpOffset * 0.7)
  local bodyBobX = currentBobOffset.X * 0.3

  rootJoint.C0 = originalRootC0 
   * CFrame.new(bodyBobX, bodyBobY, 0)
   * CFrame.Angles(currentBodyTilt.X, currentBodyTilt.Y, currentBodyTilt.Z)
 end
end)

scripts.title: Universal ESP
scripts.features:
Simple and clean Universal ESP script built with Rayfield UI.

Features:
- Fixed Bounding Box ESP (accurate sizes)
- Tracers ESP
- Name ESP
- Color Pickers for customization
- Smooth performance & auto-cleanup on player leave
scripts.script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "ESP Script",
   LoadingTitle = "ESP Rayfield",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Fixed Boxes",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("ESP Settings", 4483362458)

local ESP = {
    Boxes = false,
    Tracers = false,
    Names = false,
    BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 136),
    TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    NameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local box = Drawing.new("Square")
    box.Visible = false
    box.Thickness = 1.5
    box.Filled = false

    local tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    tracer.Visible = false
    tracer.Thickness = 1

    local name = Drawing.new("Text")
    name.Visible = false
    name.Size = 14
    name.Center = true
    name.Outline = true

    local connection
    connection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local character = player.Character
        if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
            
    
            local cframe, size = character:GetBoundingBox()
            local hrpPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(cframe.Position)

            if onScreen then
       
                local topPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)
                local bottomPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint((cframe * CFrame.new(0, -size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)

                local height = math.abs(topPos.Y - bottomPos.Y)
                local width = height * 0.65

                -- 1. Box ESP
                if ESP.Boxes then
                    box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                    box.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X - width / 2, topPos.Y)
                    box.Color = ESP.BoxColor
                    box.Visible = true
                else
                    box.Visible = false
                end

                -- 2. Tracer ESP
                if ESP.Tracers then
                    tracer.From = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    tracer.To = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, bottomPos.Y)
                    tracer.Color = ESP.TracerColor
                    tracer.Visible = true
                else
                    tracer.Visible = false
                end

                -- 3. Name ESP
                if ESP.Names then
                    name.Position = Vector2.new(hrpPos.X, topPos.Y - 16)
                    name.Text = player.DisplayName or player.Name
                    name.Color = ESP.NameColor
                    name.Visible = true
                else
                    name.Visible = false
                end
            else
                box.Visible = false
                tracer.Visible = false
                name.Visible = false
            end
        else
            box.Visible = false
            tracer.Visible = false
            name.Visible = false

            if not Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
                box:Remove()
                tracer:Remove()
                name:Remove()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end
    end)
end

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    createESP(player)
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(createESP)

-- Mobile & PC Draggable Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

DashButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = DashButton.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

DashButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- 3. SPIN DASH MECHANIC
-- ========================================================
local isDashing = false

local animR6 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR6.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://278828913"

local animR15 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR15.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://582855105"

local function performSpinDash()
    if isDashing then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not root then return end
    
    isDashing = true
    
    -- Load Animation safely
    local animTrack
    pcall(function()
        local animToPlay = (humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and animR6 or animR15
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
        animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animToPlay)
        animTrack:Play()
    end)
    
    -- Physics Setup
    local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Parent = root
    
    local linearVel = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    linearVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    linearVel.MaxForce = 999999
    linearVel.VectorVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 60
    linearVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    linearVel.Parent = root
    
    local angularVel = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
    angularVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    angularVel.MaxTorque = 999999
    angularVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
    angularVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    angularVel.Parent = root
    
    task.wait(0.5)
    
    linearVel:Destroy()
    angularVel:Destroy()
    attachment:Destroy()
    
    if animTrack then
        pcall(function()
            animTrack:Stop()
            animTrack:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    
    isDashing = false
end

DashButton.Activated:Connect(performSpinDash)
